title: Coolant Spec K-7
text: The drill's coolant is a glycol mix with an additive package listed on your manifest only as K-7. The formula is classified above your clearance, which the crew finds funny, since they pump it by hand. It will not freeze, it will not boil at drill room temperatures, and after long use it glows faintly blue in the dark. A cold spring kilometers down carries the same package in quantity, with no plant or pipe in sight. Either the supplier found the spring, or the spring found the supplier. Procurement declined to say which came first.
teaser: The coolant formula is classified. A spring down here knows it.
